notes: The two occurrences of ἐβαπτίσθημεν are matched in Greek order to the two English were baptized phrases: the first governs εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν and the second εἰς τὸν θάνατον αὐτοῦ, which is how the English clauses divide.

ὅσοι heads on all, the word realizing the quantifier's own lexeme, as rule 104 heads ὅσα → how much soever on much and ὅσαι → how many soever be on many; heading on the relativizer who remains defensible.
τόν is unrepresented because the genitive αὐτοῦ is free to take his and occupies the determiner slot (rule 20).
